conviction_note: The H1 sales line was pre-released on 21 Oct (LfL +7.1%) and the FY27 PBT guide of £55-65m was reiterated, so the release adds the H1 profit number, H2-to-date trading, the dividend and any narrowing of a wide £10m range. I found no unpriced company-level fact on those lines. Two small proxy findings offset (BRC October non-food flat against the 8.6% de-rating since 21 Oct), so impact_sum is +0.1 and p_up 52 on an abs move of 4.5, giving +0.18.

already_public.what: H1 FY27 (26 weeks to 2 Oct 2026) group LfL +7.1%, Retail +7.7% (Motoring +7.3%, Cycling +8.3%), Autocentres ex-Avayler +6.1%. FY27 underlying PBT guide of £55-65m reiterated, with profit weighted to H1 because marketing and technology investment is accelerated in H2. Interims scheduled for 26 Nov.

Unscheduled upgrade of FY27 underlying PBT to £55-65m, against the then consensus of £52.6m (range £48.9-55.1m). Weather added mid-single-digit £m of profit, and performance is weighted further to H1.

new_in_release.expect: H1 underlying PBT, reported for the first time. It should be large and well up year on year, given the H1 weighting the company has flagged, but it sits inside guidance the market was told to expect. No change expected.

The FY27 range of £55-65m is wide, and with H1 banked a narrowing is plausible. Direction unknown: the upper half would be positive; the midpoint plus a quantified H2 investment would be negative. No sourced pointer either way.

bar: FY27 underlying PBT guide of £55-65m, from the company (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/eqs/halfords-group--hfd/halfords-group-plc-trading-update-for-the-26-/9833184). Pre-upgrade consensus was £52.6m (same company source, 27 Aug). No post-upgrade consensus or H1 PBT consensus could be sourced, so the findings are capped small.
session_check: bmo: the company's own 21 Oct RNS says 'Our next update will be our HY27 interim results announcement scheduled for 26 November 2026'. Every prior Halfords results RNS went out at 07:00 (e.g. 21-Oct-2026 07:00, 25-Jun-2026 07:00 on Investegate), and the Engage Investor presentation is at 12:00 GMT on 26 Nov (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/eqs/halfords-group--hfd/halfords-group-plc-engage-investor-presentat-/9876974).
positioning_check: FCA aggregated register: 0.29% on 2026-11-10, down from 0.31% (−0.02pp), so slightly covering. Not crowded. https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/documents/aggregated-current-net-short-positions.csv (as of 2026-11-24).

findings.finding: The stock fell about 8% on the in-line 21 Oct update and is down a further 7.4% over 20 sessions to 243.5p. Peel Hunt called that update 'bullish' and Panmure Liberum put the sell-off down to profit-taking after an 85% YTD run, not to fundamentals. The H2-weighting caution is therefore at least partly in the price before the interims.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior interims moved −19.1% (Nov 2023), +13.3% (Nov 2024) and −3.1% (Nov 2025). The 21 Oct 2026 in-line update with H2-weighting language moved −8.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by definition: this is an inference that the de-rating has reset the bar. If the market were still paying for the summer momentum, the stock would sit near the 256-280p range of 21 Oct, not at 243p with 20d/60d run-ups of −7.4%/−8.1%.
findings.independence: The baseline tape (run_up_20d −7.41%, run_up_60d −8.11%) is the only other pointer; it is not an independent fundamental source.

findings.finding: BRC-KPMG for October 2026 had UK non-food sales flat y/y (in-store non-food −1.1%) while Barclays card fuel spending jumped 22.7%. That is a soft discretionary backdrop for the first weeks of Halfords' H2, the half where the company is already stepping up costs.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Weak current trading or H2 language drove the −26.7% (Feb 2024) and −8.6% (Oct 2026) moves; a weather-led strong current trading drove +10.8% (Aug 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: It is a public macro series, so largely priced; it is a proxy and the transmission is unproven. About 80% of Halfords' sales are motoring needs (servicing, MOT, parts), which is less discretionary than BRC non-food, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2026/11/11/britain039s-retail-sales-modest-in-october-brc reports the same BRC release, so it is not independent.

searched_and_found_nothing: Investegate /company/HFD RNS history, Oct-Nov 2026: no pre-close statement, no profit warning, no M&A or financing items. The only filings are an Engage presentation notice, a director appointment (Keith Down as audit chair successor, Tom Singer leaving 31 Dec) and TR-1s.
TR-1 filings by Barclays Capital Securities (5.43% → 5.37% → below 5%, 3-13 Nov) and JPMorgan Securities (5.15% then below, Oct): broker trading-book positions, no directional read.
No interim preview or post-upgrade consensus for H1/FY27 PBT found. Investing.com average target of about 294p is snippet_only and unverified.
UK Budget 2026 was 28 Oct (https://www.covermagazine.co.uk/news/4533796/john-healeys-autumn-budget-set-october), so no budget event falls in the window.
No Met Office source for a Nov 2026 cold snap (winter-product demand); searches returned only 2025 and Jan 2026 events.
Sharecast, Proactive and Investors' Chronicle are 403 by definition and were not retried. The HL article body did not extract and directorstalkinterviews returned a Cloudflare challenge.

baseline_tension: priced_lean_pct is +0.585, mostly from the negative run-up read as mean reversion. The de-rating finding agrees with it; the BRC proxy cuts mildly against. Net, the findings barely lean with the lean, so the scaled number stays near zero.
language_note: Domestic sources (City AM, Investegate RNS, AJ Bell) carried the broker quotes on the 21 Oct sell-off (Peel Hunt 'bullish', Panmure Liberum 'profit-taking', IG) and the TR-1 trail. International and wire search added nothing beyond these, so the domestic sources were effectively the whole information set; nothing they carried was unpriced.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0' and 'pre-released period, unchanged guide → ~3% move': abs_move_pct cut from 5.5 to 4.5 (kept above 3 because the wide £55-65m range may be narrowed, which is a guidance event) and p_up moved from 53 to 52.
'A narrow proxy loses / macro transmission is a hypothesis': BRC finding cut from −0.5 to −0.3.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not to agree with': de-rating finding cut from +0.5 to +0.4, since it agrees with the run-up lean.
